newsitem.title: AUSTRALIA: RTRS-Santos discovers new oil field.
newsitem.headline: RTRS-Santos discovers new oil field.

text.p: Santos Ltd said on Thursday it had discovered a new oil field in the South Australian part of the Cooper-Eromanga Basin.

Santos said the discovery well, Tarragon 1, flowed at a rate of 500 barrels of oil per day from the interval 2,806 metres to 2,312 metres in the Triassic Tinchoo Formation. The flow was recorded through a 19 mm surface choke.

It said Tarragon 1 is located about 11 km north of the Moomba gas plant, eight km north of the Cuttapirrie oil/gas field and 35 km from the oil production facility at the Keleary Field. "An early connection opportunity exists due to the close proximity of the well to the existing facilities at the Keleary field," Santos said.
Santos has a 86.4592 percent interest in Tarragon 1, Boral Ltd owns 10.5360 percent and Crusader Resources, a unit of Clyde Petroleum Plc, owns 2.9688 percent.
